messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

message.content:
The best time to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for, but most travelers find the shoulder seasons—**April through June** and **September through November**—to be ideal. During these months you’ll enjoy:

| Season | Typical Weather | Crowds | Prices |
|--------|-----------------|--------|--------|
| **Spring (Apr‑Jun)** | Warm, sunny days (70–80 °F / 21–27 °C) with cooler evenings | Fewer tourists than summer | Lower accommodation rates |
| **Summer (Jul‑Aug)** | Hot, humid (80–90 °F / 27–32 °C) | Peak season, crowded beaches | Highest hotel and flight costs |
| **Fall (Sep‑Nov)** | Pleasant temperatures (75–85 °F / 24–29 °C) | Fewer crowds after school holidays | Moderate rates |
| **Winter (Dec‑Mar)** | Cooler mornings (60–70 °F / 15–21 °C), occasional rain | Good for surfing, but some resorts close | Lowest rates, but more unpredictable weather |

If you’re a beach‑bumming tourist, April–June and September–November give you the best balance of sunshine, comfortable temperatures, and lower prices. If you’re a surfer, the winter months (especially December–January) bring larger swells, but the weather can be cooler and some hotels may be closed.
